newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs may dip to 135.30, but upside intact.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs may dip to 135.30, but upside intact.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will continue to consolidate with dips below the pivot level of 135.90 towards 135.30 possible, but the rampant uptrend is likely to resume medium term, technical analysts said on Monday.
Any sour news from the French state audit could knock the market on Monday, but analysts said Italian bonds had yet to show any signs that charts had topped.
David Sneddon at Credit Suisse First Boston in London said the September contract could slide to the crucial 135-36/30 level, the low of the current range.
By 0814 GMT, September BTPs were 0.34 down at 136.08.
